connectorUiConfig.title: CCF Observability — Error Injection Test API
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: A **controllable mock data source** for testing the Connector Diagnostics Agent in Microsoft Security Copilot. Deploy the included Azure Function App, point this connector at it, and use the switch endpoints (`/api/switchapikey`, `/api/switchhttpstatus`, `/api/switchempty`, `/api/switchlatency`, `/api/switchpagination`) to inject specific error conditions on demand. Then open the connector in Sentinel and trigger the Diagnostics Agent to observe how it surfaces and explains each induced error. Call `/api/revert` at any time to return to a healthy state.

sampleQueries.query:
CCFObservabilityEvents_CL
| summarize Count = count() by Action
| sort by Count desc

CCFObservabilityEvents_CL
| where Severity in ('high', 'critical')
| project TimeGenerated, EventId, SourceIp, DestinationIp, Action, Severity, Protocol

dataTypes.name: CCFObservabilityEvents_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
CCFObservabilityEvents_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

value:
CCFObservabilityEvents_CL
| summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
| project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(1d)

customs.name: CCF Observability Function App
customs.description: The CCF Observability Function App must be deployed before configuring this connector. See STEP 1 below.

instructionSteps.title: STEP 1 — Deploy the CCF Observability Function App
instructionSteps.description:
Deploy the Azure Function App that serves as the controllable mock data source:

1. Create a resource group and storage account:
```
az group create -n ccf-obs-rg -l eastus
az storage account create -n ccfobsstorage -g ccf-obs-rg --sku Standard_LRS
```
2. Create the Function App (Linux, Python 3.11):
```
az functionapp create -n <functionAppName> -g ccf-obs-rg --consumption-plan-location eastus --runtime python --runtime-version 3.11 --functions-version 4 --storage-account ccfobsstorage --os-type Linux
```
3. Deploy the code from the `FunctionApp/` folder:
```
# From the FunctionApp/ directory:
Compress-Archive -Path .\* -DestinationPath ccf-obs.zip
az functionapp deployment source config-zip -n <functionAppName> -g ccf-obs-rg --src ccf-obs.zip --build-remote true
```
4. Note the deployed URL: `https://<functionAppName>.azurewebsites.net`

The connector polls `/api/main` using API key `abc123`. Use the switch endpoints to inject errors:
- `POST /api/switchapikey` — rotate the accepted key (connector gets **HTTP 401**)
- `POST /api/switchhttpstatus?code=429` — force any HTTP 4xx/5xx
- `POST /api/switchempty` — return 200 with zero records
- `POST /api/switchlatency?delay_seconds=70` — inject a timeout
- `POST /api/switchpagination` — corrupt pagination (infinite loop)
- `POST /api/revert` — reset all switches to defaults

instructionSteps.title: STEP 2 — Connect to the Observability API
instructionSteps.description: Enter the base URL of your deployed Function App and click **Connect**.
